note: An example brief. Every person is invented. Describe a moment in a sentence or two; the tool refuses a brief that carries a date, a number that could identify someone, a contact detail or a name on the protected list, and one that asks for a conversation a short scene cannot hold.

scenes.moment: Gus has decided to take a month off work so that he can be home every day. He announces it as good news. Nell has not been asked.
